Implement reports.export.export_csv(rows, columns).

rows is an iterable of mappings; columns is an ordered iterable of unique string
column names. Return a str containing CSV header then one record per row, in that
order. Use comma delimiters, CRLF record endings, RFC 4180 minimal quoting and
quote doubling; preserve embedded CR/LF and Unicode. Missing fields and None
become empty strings. Other values become str(value). Ignore unselected fields.
Support one-shot generators for rows and columns, empty rows, and empty columns.
Reject duplicate or non-string column names with ValueError. Do not mutate inputs.
